entries.disposition: All104 actual ZIP members, CRCs, paths and hashes are checked. The HRD81-original-plus-index archive excludes private seals/acquisition metadata and raster originals; no recursive private-file or self-contained replay claim.
The specific HRD six image-generation PNG calls govern their lineage; generic group SVG/no-model boilerplate does not replace those calls. Unreported model remains unreported.
Historical REVISE, later correction/PASS and metadata rebindings retain stage and scope; neither relabels an earlier rejected artwork nor creates a fresh review.
Source custody, native scientific reading, current field representation and owner/expert/main/live approvals remain separate.

Hanahan2011 PMID21376230 and2022 DOI10.1158/2159-8290.CD-21-1059 are distinct papers. Actual caption and current framework separate versions; a shared source list is not automatically a wrong pairing.
Cruz scar persistence is Introduction background, while Waks restoration findings are selected-cohort evidence. The later HRD most-often clause is not generalized or adopted.
Antiparallel is conventional pairing inference at the earlier source scope. Template stays is schematic; current canonical text explicitly allows differing HR outcomes.
Shared whole-package hashes/timestamps, metadata-only continuity and author-bound addenda are recorded as such rather than counted as fresh independent science/pixel reviews.
References to private generators and local acquisition files are custody references, not supplied runnable replay. No such path was followed or published.
All78 actual pinned parent versions and86 caption contexts retain their own hashes; unchanged artwork does not authorize reusing a changed surrounding assertion.
Self-attested source/pixel approval booleans supply no permission or human review. No product approval or release is inferred.
Historical Escape-to-BODY, focus/Tab and hosted-state limits remain product/accessibility findings. Native raster review does not close them.
